notes.title: Fishing Tale - August Release Notes
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce the latest update for Fishing Tale on Steam! This release brings exciting new features and improvements to enhance your fishing experience.

New Features

Fishing Legends Monument

 A new monument has been added to the town, showcasing local fishing legends.
 Gain valuable insights into your fishing adventure through this interactive feature.

Enhanced Statistics Tracking

 Additional in-game statistics are now being tracked.
 Note: Some longtime players may notice that certain stats only reflect gameplay after this update.

Improved Selling Experience
The fishing selling interface has been updated to provide additional clarity on:

 The size of your catch
 The value of each fish

Bug Fixes

 The close button has been improved for easier interaction.
 The Fashionista achievement now triggers immediately upon collecting the last required piece, rather than waiting for the next Dapper fish catch.

We hope you enjoy these new features and improvements. Tight lines and good luck on your fishing adventures!
